title: Simulation of a live counter run
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S,H$ be types, and let $tm$ and $host$ be Boolean-alphabet machines with respectively $k$ and $k+1$ work tapes. Let $emb:S\to H$ and $ret:\mathrm{Bool}\to H$, and suppose that for every state $q$, Boolean flag $over$, input symbol option $inp$, and tuple $work$ of work-tape symbols, the transition of $host$ from state $emb(q,over)$ agrees with the lifted action formed from the transition of $tm$ on blank input and the last $k$ work tapes. For Boolean words $w,s$, a configuration $c$ of $tm$ on empty input, and a natural number $t$, suppose that the run from $c$ is not halted at any time $j<t$. Then after $t$ steps, $host$ started from the counter configuration associated with $c$ is exactly the counter configuration associated with the configuration reached by $tm$ from $c$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: tm has k work tapes and state type S
host has k+1 work tapes and state type H
the stated transition-agreement condition holds for all q, over, inp, and work
w and s are Boolean words
c is a configuration of tm over Bool on empty input
for every j < t, the configuration reached by tm at time j is not halted
